title: Alma counsels Shiblon
summary: Alma tells Shiblon to heed his words, keep God’s commandments, and endure faithfully.

explicit_facts.text: Alma says keeping God’s commandments brings prosperity in the land, while not keeping them means being cut off from God’s presence.
Alma expresses joy in Shiblon’s steadiness and faithfulness, recalls that Shiblon began looking to God in his youth, and hopes he will continue keeping the commandments.

spoken_dialogue.text: My son, give ear to my words
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Alma

spoken_dialogue.text: blessed is he that endureth to the end.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Alma

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The outcomes of keeping or not keeping commandments are counsel, not separate visible events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict prosperity or being cut off from God’s presence as a separate event.

title: Joy in Shiblon’s faithfulness
summary: Alma tells Shiblon that his faithfulness, diligence, patience, and long-suffering among the Zoramites have brought Alma joy.

explicit_facts.text: Alma says he has had great joy because of Shiblon’s faithfulness, diligence, patience, and long-suffering among the Zoramites.

explicit_facts.text: Alma urges Shiblon to remember that trust in God brings deliverance from trials, troubles, and afflictions, and lifting up at the last day.

explicit_facts.text: Alma says the Lord sent his angel to declare that Alma must stop the work of destruction among the people.

explicit_facts.text: Alma says he endured three days and three nights of bitter pain and anguish of soul, cried to the Lord Jesus Christ for mercy, received remission of sins, and found peace to his soul.

explicit_facts.text: Alma says there is no other way or means whereby people can be saved except through Christ, whom he calls the life and light of the world and the word of truth and righteousness.
